mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.leader_user_id, d.sort_no, d.status, d.remark, d.created_at, d.updated_at, u.real_name AS leader_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user m WHERE m.dept_id = d.id AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.employment_status = 1) AS member_count FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.leader_user_id WHERE d.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dept(parent_id, dept_name, dept_code, leader_user_id, sort_no, status, remark) VALUES(#{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{deptCode}, #{leaderUserId}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET deleted=1, leader_user_id=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dept WHERE parent_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE dept_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND employment_status=1 AND status=1
SELECT id FROM sys_dept ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
